mathematical_contract.image_identity: The resultant proves that the exact image beta=f(alpha) is a root of the image polynomial.
mathematical_contract.containment: Endpoint mapping is used only when the rational or polynomial derivative is certified away from zero. Otherwise exact interval evaluation gives a conservative image enclosure.
mathematical_contract.isolation: An enclosure is published only when exact Bernstein variation certifies one distinct open-interval root; repeated factors are removed only when direct variation does not decide.
mathematical_contract.refinement: Ambiguous enclosures trigger up to eight rounds of eight exact Sturm bisections of the already-isolated source root. Exhaustion remains an explicit image-isolation failure.
mathematical_contract.endpoints: A resultant root on an enclosure endpoint is not silently assigned. Refinement continues until ownership is interior or an exact rational image witness is replayed.
mathematical_contract.policy: Both policies use the same proof structure. APPROXIMATE_512 can terminate only through its ordinary 512-bit predicate boundary; no sampled coordinate or tolerance topology is introduced.

capability.comparison_revision: Polynomial images rejected stationary/nonmonotone source intervals. Rational images fell back to those polynomial images, and both paths trusted an endpoint image interval's inherited unit-root count without excluding distinct resultant roots from other source roots.
capability.source_revision: Polynomial and rational images represent stationary maps exactly, refine nonmonotone isolators, exclude foreign resultant roots, and preserve rational source/image witnesses found during refinement.
capability.hypercurve_decision: The general cubic cusp remains a retained rational point expression. Raising the rational-image dimension ceiling from 16 to 18 transformed its coordinates but increased the focused release fixture from about 4 ms to about 190 ms and forced degree-18 elimination; the experiment was reverted in favor of the smaller exact carrier substrate.

benchmark.method: adjacent-parent Criterion binaries in separate clean target directories; 30 samples, 2 s warmup, 3 s measurement

polynomial_image.interpretation: The approximately 0.50 us proof cost closes a false unit-isolation claim and enables stationary images.

linear_fractional_rational_image.interpretation: The Mobius fast path is effectively neutral.

retained_rational_map_transform.interpretation: The approximately 0.50 us local isolation proof is paid per independently selected source root while the elimination remains reused.

degree_12_cubic_rational_image.interpretation: The approximately 0.09 ms Bernstein image-isolation proof is retained because exactness outranks the bounded overhead.
